turns.question: What was the median order value on 1 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no median order value metric (median_order_value_eur is listed as not available here), so I can't give a median for 1 October 2026. The closest metrics are average_order_value_eur (average over non-cancelled orders) and revenue_eur with orders_total, and no query was run, so there is no freshness statement to quote.
